description:
Hi, I'm Dee, my skills involve Web Development(Front-end), Python, Java, and C++. If you want to contribute in making a game to help others learn about Space, we will be building a game that can educate others on Space and Planets. 

Skills I am looking for are Python, and Web Development(Front-end and Back-end).
summary: My project, Celestial Voyage Planet Explorer, involves exploring space, players choose the Moon, Mars, or Venus, build a spacecraft that fits your mission requirements, and make choices during their voyage to collect science and reach their destination. This addresses the Space Mission Game Design challenge because it allows the players to design a spacecraft based on power, budget, and resources to reach their destination. This is important because we learn how scientists and engineers take data collection seriously, pictures, landing safely, all while saving fuel into consideration and manage to create a rocket that takes scientists to planets.
details:
Celestial Voyage Planet Explorer is an interactive space exploration game that teaches players how to plan and design their own space missions built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in Visual Studio Code . Players can choose between three destinations, the Moon, Mars, and Venus, each with different difficulty levels and mission requirements. Choose a destination then players build their spacecraft by selecting engines, solar panels, shields, antennas, and instruments. Each component affects the spacecraft's budget, mass, fuel, power, and overall performance. Once the spacecraft is ready, players launch their mission and face challenges that require them to make decisions. Their choices determine whether the mission succeeds or fails.

The main goal of Celestial Voyage is to make learning about space exploration and engineering more fun and understandable on how scientists and engineers use budget, power, resources to build rockets. It encourages players to solve problems, and understand how important planning is when designing a space mission with the effects of the pros and cons. Instead of just reading about space missions, players get to experience the decision-making process themselves. The game is built with considered accessibility, visual design, and how different spacecraft components affect mission success.
